name: Baastrup Disease / Kissing Spine
definition: Degenerative approximation and remodeling of adjacent spinous processes, sometimes associated with interspinous bursitis and extension-related midline back pain.

investigations.principle: Radiographs/CT show approximation and sclerosis; MRI can demonstrate interspinous edema/bursitis.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, marrow, tumor, occult injury or condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific imaging pathway.

amber: Imaging findings may be incidental; intervention requires strong clinical correlation.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Kati-shoola phenotype may be documented descriptively.

patientEducation.summary: Degenerative approximation and remodeling of adjacent spinous processes, sometimes associated with interspinous bursitis and extension-related midline back pain.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, sphincter change, severe infection/systemic illness, major trauma, vascular compromise or other listed red flags.
